name: Deschutes County, OR
findings: Deschutes County has 585 nonprofit organizations. 275 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 215 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Deschutes County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Deschutes County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
